Prestar Resources Bhd Appoints New Executive Director to Drive Growth Ambitions

KUALA LUMPUR – Prestar Resources Bhd, a prominent player in Malaysia’s steel industry, has announced the appointment of Tan Sri Mohd Azlan Rahman as its new Executive Director, effective July 1. The appointment is part of the company’s ongoing efforts to strengthen its leadership team and position itself for further expansion, both locally and abroad.

In a statement to Bursa Malaysia, Prestar Resources Bhd said that Tan Sri Mohd Azlan brings more than 25 years of experience in the metals and manufacturing sector. Prior to joining Prestar, he held senior management roles at several leading regional industrial firms and is known for his expertise in operational efficiency, sustainability initiatives, and corporate strategy.

“We are delighted to welcome Tan Sri Mohd Azlan Rahman to the board,” said Dato’ Lim Chee Wah, Group Managing Director of Prestar Resources Bhd. “His vision and proven leadership will be instrumental as we pursue new growth opportunities and continue our commitment to innovation and value creation for our stakeholders.”

Analysts say the appointment comes at a timely moment, as Malaysia’s steel industry navigates a challenging but promising landscape. According to the Malaysian Iron and Steel Federation, domestic steel demand is expected to grow by 4% in 2024, supported by infrastructure projects and a recovering construction sector.

“Prestar’s move to strengthen its leadership reflects a keen awareness of the industry’s evolving dynamics,” said Nurul Izzati, senior analyst at Seraya Research. “Having a seasoned executive like Tan Sri Mohd Azlan on board could help the company accelerate its expansion plans and adapt to shifting market conditions.”

Tan Sri Mohd Azlan said he is honoured to join Prestar Resources Bhd at this pivotal juncture. “Prestar has a solid track record and a reputation for quality and reliability. I look forward to working closely with the team to enhance our operational excellence, embrace sustainable practices, and explore new markets for growth,” he said in a prepared statement.

Prestar Resources Bhd, listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia, manufactures and supplies steel pipes, guardrails, and various steel products to local and regional markets. The company reported a revenue of RM 870 million for the financial year ended December 2023, an increase of 6% from the previous year.

Shares of Prestar Resources Bhd ended unchanged at RM 0.96 following the announcement. Market participants will be watching closely for further updates on the company’s strategic direction under its new executive leadership.
